title: Compensation & Benefits | HR Tier | BackOfficeFleet
description: Compensation and benefits operating page for trucking HR teams coordinating pay support, benefit status, deductions, reimbursements, and owner follow-up.
html:
HR Tier / Compensation & Benefits

Keep pay and benefit support tied to the records behind it.

Trucking pay questions often involve trips, accessorials, reimbursements, deductions, contractor packets, benefit enrollment, leave context, or manager approvals. BOF gives the office a clean support view while final payroll, tax, classification, and benefit decisions remain with the responsible parties.

HR TierPayroll Administration

Support boundary

BOF organizes visibility; it does not make payroll, tax, legal, or benefits determinations.

The value is coordination: the record, reason, owner, and next action are no longer scattered.

Compensation support

Make the reason for a pay question visible.

Track the load, stop, detention, deduction, reimbursement, approval, settlement note, or missing document behind the issue.

  • Trip or settlement reference
  • Supporting receipt or approval
  • Owner and due date
  • Resolution status
Benefits coordination

Show where enrollment or worker support stands.

Keep benefit-related follow-up visible with status, owner, needed document, and handoff notes while plan administration stays with the appropriate provider or administrator.

  • Enrollment status
  • Missing forms
  • Leave or status context
  • Escalation owner
